_about: Default-video preset: a ready project config for the video the skill assumes when the user names no other video. Copy it as project.json; only the slides, the narration (sentences.json / subtitles.json) and the slide-driven events are still to be supplied. Values were measured on this video (source times in seconds, 1080p coordinates). rights.voice_clone_authorized stays false here: set it in the project copy only after the user chose voice cloning for this video.

rights.output: local file only; the user decides on any publication

source._measured: 3840x2160 AV1 60 fps, 496.00 s, AAC 44.1 kHz stereo

cut._why: Right after the delivery scene: the receiver's thank-you ends at 51.55, the next caption appears at 51.667 (one 60 fps frame). Freeze frame 51.633 (last frame without that caption); dialogue valley 51.60-51.75 (-31 to -41 dBFS). The insert returns to 51.65 in the same shot, so the built-in white flash is required.

default_video._about: Facts about this video that the pipeline steps need. Each recipe names the script or command that consumes it (SKILL.md, 'Default video').

spoken._note: 48.40-48.50 is a silent gap used as slot room. Said alone the word took 0.8-1.7 s and fell after the second mora, so it is read inside the carrier sentence and extracted (word_tools.py extract). Delivered: 0.601 s at 1.092x. fit_word.py on the extraction chose 1.083x, which gives 0.609 s and overruns the 0.60 s slot, so the delivered take was sped to 1.092x to fit.
